newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan in close contact with Thai authorities--MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan in close contact with Thai authorities--MOF.

text.p: Japan is keeping in close contact with Thai authorities and will come up with necessary measures to help Thailand's economy once Bangkok and the International Monetary Fund (IMF) reach a final agreement over an economic rescue package, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Tuesday.

"We are keeping in close contact (with the Thai authorities)," Mitsuzuka said. "Japan will come up with necessary measures as soon as possible, once there is an agreement (between Thailand and the IMF)," he added.
He said that Japan was not aware of any final agreement and said he hoped the ongoing talks between Thailand and the IMF would reach a successful agreement.
